description: Vibrant abstract logo with signature hot-pink solid base and electric cyan vertical gradient overlay. The glow layer features a gentle, living breath pulse that creates a dynamic energy effect while staying 100% faithful to the original geometry, proportions, and brand colors (#FF005C + #00E0FF).

palette_groups.note: Core hot magenta-pink brand color for the solid logo shape
Electric cyan glow family for the vertical energy gradient — allows beautiful subtle shifts while staying true to the original #00E0FF vibe

motion_groups.note: Gentle pulsating breath on the cyan gradient overlay — gives the logo a living, high-energy neon feel without being distracting
